§bMy Mods§r

Your own mods, all in one place. Each row below is one mod: the first quest explains it, the others are its key items.

§bQuest & UI§r: GTNH Addon Quests (this book, the objective panel, AE2 counting, NEI bookmarks, the scripts floppy).
§bFarming§r: Seed Bags, GTNH Greenhouse, Tree Sim Compat.
§bMining§r: Cheaper Void Miners, GT Not Hard (Singularity NEI tabs).
§bAE2 & patterns§r: Super Pattern Maker (with the Maintaining Input Hatch and Autocrafting Monitor), Pattern Router, Wildcard Pattern and Pattern Gen NC editions.
§bHelpers§r: Free Build Projector, Quest Kit, GTNH Planner.

Rows for mods that aren't installed are hidden automatically.
